items.title: 67802_Charles Mingus oral history interview
items.q: INTERVIEWEE: What was that the attorney he said last night, Sue, that Paul Desmond didn't get much money?

ctx.x: Yeah, but Brubeck sold millions of records. Brubeck couldn't swing his way out of a paper bag, but he was an enormous popular success. He sold millions of copies of those quartet records with of Paul Desmond.
What was that the attorney he said last night, Sue, that Paul Desmond didn't get much money?
He said that when he oversaw the latest (Inaudible) contract with Paul Desmond, Paul did start getting artist royalties and very quickly.
